This vignette shows an example analysis of yellow toad microsatellite data from Prohl et al. 2021, used to produce Figure 7 from Lim et al.

```{r setup}
library(PopGenBounds)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
```

We load the dataset
```{r}
Toad_microsat_freq = PopGenBounds::Toad_microsat_freq
toad_genotypes <- PopGenBounds::toad_genotypes
```

# Plotting the allele frequency tables
```{r}
# allele frequency table for the first locus
ggfreqtable(Toad_microsat_freq[[3]])
```

# Computing the statistics
For all subpopulations together (K=47)
```{r}
Diff_toad = lapply(Toad_microsat_freq,Diff)
```

For pairs of subpopulations (K=2)
```{r}
Diff_toad_pairs = lapply(Toad_microsat_freq,function(f){sapply(1:46, function(i){ sapply((i+1):47, function(j) Diff(f[c(i,j),])$value)})} )
```

# Computing bootstrap confidence intervals
For all subpopulations together (K=47)
```{r}
set.seed(25)
res <- boot_stat(toad_genotypes, stat_fun = Diff, B = 10, type="basic")
res$mean             # check the labels in the 'statistic' column
```


```{r}
out_dir <- "C:/Users/limy/OneDrive - International Agency for Research on Cancer/Documents/NoahCollab/code/output"
write.csv(res$mean, file.path(out_dir, "toad_mean_ci_ratio_of_averages.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# save bootstrap statistics
per_locus <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(res$estimate), function(l)
  cbind(locus = l, res$estimate[[l]])))

#write.csv(per_locus, "../../output/toad_per_locus_basic_ci.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


# Plotting the data
For K=47
```{r}
toad.tib = tibble(M=unlist( sapply(Diff_toad,function(x){x[1,2]})),
                  FST=unlist( sapply(Diff_toad,function(x){x[2,2]})),
                  GpST=unlist( sapply(Diff_toad,function(x){x[3,2]})),
                  D=unlist( sapply(Diff_toad,function(x){x[4,2]})))

ggtoad = ggbounds_raw(M=toad.tib$M,FST=toad.tib$FST,GpST=toad.tib$GpST,D=toad.tib$D,K=47, ci=res$mean, density_colors = FALSE, ci_style="bands")

ggtoad[[1]]+ ggtoad[[2]]+ ggtoad[[3]]
```


```{r}
fig <- ggtoad[[1]] + ggtoad[[2]] + ggtoad[[3]] + plot_layout(guides = "collect")
#ggsave("Toad_files/figures/toad_bounds_CI_bands_ratio_averages.pdf", fig, width = 7, height = 2.3)
```

For K=bp

```{r}
toad.tib_pairs = tibble(M=as.numeric(sapply(Diff_toad_pairs, function(x) unlist(sapply(x,function(y){y[1,]})))),
                  FST=as.numeric(sapply(Diff_toad_pairs, function(x) unlist(sapply(x,function(y){y[2,]})))),
                  GpST=as.numeric(sapply(Diff_toad_pairs, function(x) unlist(sapply(x,function(y){y[3,]})))),
                  D=as.numeric(sapply(Diff_toad_pairs, function(x) unlist(sapply(x,function(y){y[4,]})))) )

# when M=1, no polymorphism, so we exclude the locus
toad.tib_pairs = toad.tib_pairs %>% filter(M<1)

ggtoad_pairs = ggbounds(M=toad.tib_pairs$M,FST=toad.tib_pairs$FST,GpST=toad.tib_pairs$GpST,D=toad.tib_pairs$D,K=2)

ggtoad_pairs[[1]]+ ggtoad_pairs[[2]]+ ggtoad_pairs[[3]]

```

gg_pairs <- ggtoad_pairs[[1]]+ scale_color_viridis_c(limits=c(0,5000)) +guides(color="none") + 
  (ggtoad_pairs[[2]]+ scale_color_viridis_c(limits=c(0,5000)) +guides(color="none") ) +
